create_RFE: create an RFE feature selector with a linear estimator to rank features by importance
create_RFECV: create an RFECV feature selector with cross-validation to automatically determine the optimal number of features
run_RFE_fit: run the RFE fit method to eliminate features recursively based on estimator importance
run_RFE_predict: run the RFE predict method to reduce input data to selected features and predict
run_RFECV_score: run the RFECV score method to evaluate feature selection performance using a scoring metric
